title: Synchronize SDK version matrix and soft-deprecate legacy request params
text:
Synchronize SDK version matrix and soft-deprecate legacy request params

description:
Audit and align the public SDK version support matrix across Python, JavaScript, and Go clients, and introduce a soft-deprecation path for two legacy request parameters (legacy_response and old_prompt_format) that are still used by a small set of downstream customers. The work includes dependency bumps required for runtime-1.21 compatibility, adding runtime feature flags to each SDK, implementing backwards-compatible shims with detailed warnings, and rolling out telemetry to measure migration progress. The goal is to reduce maintenance overhead, enable the runtime to use newer kernel selection APIs, and prepare for a stricter API surface cleanup in 6–8 weeks while minimizing customer disruption.

acceptance_criteria:
Create and publish a synchronized version matrix page listing minimum supported SDK versions for runtime-1.21 and earlier runtimes
Ship SDK releases with dependency bumps: python-sdk >=2.0.0, js-sdk >=1.0.0, go-sdk >=0.9.0
Introduce soft-deprecation warnings when legacy_response or old_prompt_format is present in request payloads (warning logged and standard header added to responses)
Deploy telemetry pipelines that surface migration % by customer and by endpoint in Grafana dashboard
Provide migration guide and automated codemods for Python and JS clients in the repo docs
No regression in generation latency or memory usage >5% on the regression suite and nightly performance runs

tasks:
Audit repositories to identify code paths relying on legacy_response and old_prompt_format
Draft synchronized version matrix markdown and add to SDK docs site
Prepare python-sdk v2.0.0 candidate: bump deps (requests 2.31, urllib3 2.x), add deprecation warning hooks
Prepare js-sdk v1.0.0 candidate: bump deps (node-fetch -> undici), update TypeScript types for new feature flags
Prepare go-sdk v0.9.0 candidate: bump deps (grpc, go-resty), add feature-flag toggle via env var
Implement server-side lightweight compatibility header (X-RW-Legacy-Used) and emit structured telemetry
Ship canary releases to 5% of hosted traffic and monitor error/latency traces
Create codemods: python (rope-based) and js (jscodeshift) to migrate old_prompt_format->structured_prompt
Coordinate with Solutions Eng and Customer Success to pre-notify high-usage customers and offer migration support
Write release notes and migration guide with examples and rollback steps

notes:
Initial audit found ~12 internal routes and 3 external customers still depending on old_prompt_format
We will use a 6-week soft-deprecation window: warnings only for the first 4 weeks, then opt-in strict mode during week 5, then enforce removal in 6-8 weeks if migration progress <75%
Decision: prefer additive changes and warning-first approach rather than immediate breaking changes to protect uptime
Performance trade-off: new undici-based JS transport reduces median p95 for small payloads but requires validation for streaming paths
Security review: dependency bumps include minor OpenSSL bindings; Snyk scan must be green before publishing
Follow-up: schedule a post-mortem checklist for any customer regressions and a rollback playbook for each SDK

review_feedback:
PM Sofia Martín: please include explicit rollback commands and expected downtime (if any) in release notes
Infra Diego Ruiz: prefer canary by customer tier rather than random traffic for Dedicated customers
Security Priya Rao: require vulnerability sign-off from security team for each third-party bump
DX Lead Hana Okafor: codemods should be included in the quickstart templates and workshop materials
